en: The Triplet on the Cause of Seeing (Dassanahetuttika)

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by vision … pe … dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation … pe … dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation … (Abbreviated.

Under the root condition there are thirty-one; under the object condition, twenty-eight; under the predominance condition, twenty-nine … pe … under the resultant condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, thirty-one.
